links.outcome: Validity of reference standard: planted keys versus human dispositions and detector outputs
links.effect: Scoring imported plant keys yields 22/(22+9)=0.710 and 22/(22+79)=0.218, which are proposal-confirmation yield and ledger composition, not judge precision and recall; only 3 reviewed targets double annotated.
links.quote: A direct audit identity shows that these values are proposal-confirmation yield and submitted-ledger composition, not judge precision and recall, because no independent detector realization was preserved for the audited proposals in the available records.
